fusions.name: Herding Volley
fusions.desc: Looses a wide fan of arrows 6 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 damage to everything in it and drives it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Yoked Team
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 8 damage and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you (max 32%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Chewing Cud
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 18 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Anger
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (34% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
